title: nspawn run list --caller <socket> --json, version 1
description: The runs that one Claude Code session started, newest first. nSPAWN reads them from the notice rows that name the messaging socket of the session. It removes a notice row after 7 days, and the run leaves the list with its row. A closed run can leave sooner, when nSPAWN removes its run row.

phase.description: The terminal phases are orphaned, completed, failed and closed. A run that failed stays failed after nSPAWN closes it.

lastOutputAt.description: The modification time of the stdout file of the run. Null when that file does not exist.

continuedAs.description: The run that continues the work of this failed or closed run. Null when no run continues it.
